answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let reputation grow only through verified, useful work over time. A newcomer starts with no standing, like a falcon arriving at an oasis with no history: others watch before trusting it. Sybil attackers must fund and age every fake identity separately, and bad behavior slashes the stake and cuts the vine of referrals linking it to its creator, so creating thousands of sock puppets costs far more than the rewards they could extract.
